marketing_description: The DeWALT DW089CG Green Laser Level features a 3-line laser to aid in 90-degree layout and has a working range of 165 ft with a detector and 100 ft without. This self-leveling laser level has an accuracy of +/-1/8 in at 30 ft and a leveling range of +/- 4 deg. It also includes a micro-adjust knob for precise alignment and has an IP54 rating for dust and water resistance.
